title: SURFing to the Fundamental Limit of Jet Tagging
abstract: arXiv:2511.15779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Beyond the practical goal of improving search and measurement sensitivity through better jet tagging algorithms, there is a deeper question: what are their upper performance limits? Generative surrogate models with learned likelihood functions offer a new approach to this problem, provided the surrogate correctly captures the underlying data distribution. In this work, we introduce the SUrrogate ReFerence (SURF) method, a new approach to validating generative models. This framework enables exact Neyman-Pearson tests by training the target model on samples from another tractable surrogate, which is itself trained on real data. We argue that the EPiC-FM generative model is a valid surrogate reference for JetClass jets and apply SURF to show that modern jet taggers may already be operating close to the true statistical limit. By contrast, we find that autoregressive GPT models unphysically exaggerate top vs. QCD separation power e

translated_title: 借助SURF（替代参考）方法逼近喷注标记的基本极限
translated_abstract: 超越通过更好的喷注标记算法来提升搜索和测量灵敏度这一实际目标之外，还存在一个更深层的问题：这些算法的性能上限是什么？具有学习到的似然函数的生成式替代模型为这一问题提供了一种新途径，前提是替代模型能够正确捕捉底层数据分布。在本工作中，我们提出了替代参考（SUrrogate ReFerence，SURF）方法，这是一种验证生成式模型的新途径。该框架通过在另一个易于处理的替代模型（其本身基于真实数据训练）生成的样本上训练目标模型，从而实现精确的Neyman-Pearson检验。我们论证了EPiC-FM生成模型是JetClass喷注数据的有效替代参考，并应用SURF方法表明，现代喷注标记器可能已经运行在接近真实统计极限的状态。相比之下，我们发现自回归GPT模型在物理上不合理地夸大了top喷注与QCD喷注的区分能力。
tldr: 本文提出了SURF（替代参考）验证方法，通过在可解析的替代模型样本上训练目标生成模型来实现精确的Neyman-Pearson检验，据此发现现代喷注标记器可能已接近喷注标记的真实统计极限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the SURF (SUrrogate ReFerence) method for validating generative models via exact Neyman-Pearson tests, showing that modern jet taggers may already operate close to the true statistical limit of jet tagging.
